patterns.note: Editorial-style content sections feature asymmetrical two-column layouts, often pairing a large, full-width image with a text block that has generous negative space.
A distinctive, elegant serif display font is used for prominent headings and titles, creating a sophisticated feel, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A warm, earthy color palette dominated by deep reddish-browns and off-white is consistently applied across backgrounds, text, and accents, evoking a natural and luxurious aesthetic.
The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the scroll, creating depth and a smooth visual transition.
Content sections reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport, enhancing content discovery.
A persistent, dismissible 'WORLD OF SIHA' popup appears from the bottom right after initial scroll, offering a community incentive.

technique_notes: Smooth scrolling and subtle parallax effects are applied to the hero image and other large visual elements, likely managed by locomotive-scroll, creating a fluid and engaging scroll experience.
Sections are revealed with a staggered fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery and guiding the user's attention.
A fixed header navigation maintains visibility and functionality as the user scrolls down the page, providing constant access to key site areas.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and product image containers, with mostly sharp edges for overall section blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in hero and editorial sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with a refined, editorial aesthetic that blends a rich, earthy color palette with a sophisticated serif typeface. The subtle parallax and scroll-triggered reveals contribute to a premium, unhurried browsing experience, making it feel more like a digital magazine than a typical e-commerce site.
